description: Run the block geometry check. Takes no keywords and no range: anything after the command is rejected with 'Unused extra parameter'. On 3DEC 9.8.54 it prints nothing for a sound model (checked on a rigid brick, a 48-zone brick and a 4-block DFN-cut model). Not on any manual page: which defects it reports, and how, is not documented.
notes: Listed by 'block ?' on 3DEC 9.8.54; there is no page for it in the 9.8 manual. 3DEC 7.0 has not been probed for it, so no 7.0 block is recorded.
